articles.title: Hackers Hit Supermarket Fridges Across Europe, Spoiling Food
articles.summary: A cyberattack raised fridge and freezer temperatures at dozens of European stores, echoing a similar attack in France last month, and no one has claimed responsibility.

articles.title: Judge Orders Release of Canadian Dentist Held in Minnesota
articles.summary: A federal judge ruled Dr. William Lizardo's detention violated his constitutional rights and ordered him released immediately; he is now awaiting a decision on his green card application.

articles.title: Supreme Court Says California Can Keep Counting Its Ballots
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has denied a request to set aside 20,000 California ballots, leaving lower-court rulings in place on the eve of the midterm elections.
